description: The console has no 'Recent' view and no sort. The file list is ordered by path, so recently changed files are scattered, and the MODIFIED header is inert.
expected: A sort on MODIFIED (default newest first) or a 'Recent' filter chip.
actual: Header click does nothing; newest files (1:59 PM) sit at the bottom among 11:55 AM files.
suggested_fix: Make column headers sort buttons with aria-sort; default newest first; use the existing recent API for a Recent chip.

description: The audit log is filled with the console's own list/read calls (drive.list, usage.read, keys.list...), pushing real events off the first page; it contains no file paths.
expected: Log shows security-relevant actions (writes, deletes, shares, key changes), with read-only console polling hidden or collapsed.
actual: First 25 rows were all read calls generated by page views.
suggested_fix: Hide console.*.list rows by default, add an action-type filter.

description: In 'Usage by author', the row divider under the AGENT column stops at the column edge instead of spanning the table, so rows look broken.
actual: Left cell border ends around x=514 and the other cells' borders sit slightly lower.
suggested_fix: Apply the border to the row, not individual cells.

description: The Usage tab keeps the per-drive strip with a highlighted drive although all numbers are account-wide.
expected: No selected-drive state on account-wide tabs.
suggested_fix: Hide the drive strip on Usage, or scope the tab to the selected drive.
